deferred_to_upstream.summary: Carry required-but-defaultable body members (Respond.io's search/filter/timezone trio) into syncResourceStaticBody and the generated list command's default body
deferred_to_upstream.reason: A POST-list endpoint with required body members fails 100% of syncs out of the box while the spec still looks complete.

deferred_to_upstream.summary: Distinguish query params from body params on POST list endpoints in the profiler
deferred_to_upstream.reason: Misclassified pagination params are silently ignored by the API, capping every page at the server default and breaking --all/sync page advancement.

deferred_to_upstream.summary: Teach extractPaginationFromEnvelope to parse URL-valued next fields inside pagination wrapper objects before the name-based cursorKeys scan
deferred_to_upstream.reason: Because "next" is itself a cursor key, the name-based scan wins and hands the whole URL back as the cursor, so cursor sync silently stops after page one.

deferred_to_upstream.summary: Give the generated --all pager the sticky-cursor detector and explicit page size that the sync pager already has
deferred_to_upstream.reason: Without them an --all loop inherits the API's small default page size and, on a non-advancing cursor, burns its whole page cap on duplicate requests while reporting a truncation.
